title: This Giant Heart Can Beat Just Twice a Minute
description: A blue whale's heart weighs nearly 400 pounds and can slow to two beats a minute on a dive. Your heart beats about 70.

scenes.subject: heart
scenes.text: Your heart beats about seventy times a minute.
scenes.say: Your heart beats about seventy times a minute.

scenes.text: This one can beat just twice.

scenes.text: When the whale dives, its heart slows to two beats a minute to save oxygen.
